description: This file defines message types, interfaces, and enums for communication between a web extension and background scripts, specifically related to bug report handling and issue metadata in the Android project.

classes.name: WebCommandMessage
classes.description: Base interface for all messages sent between web and extension.

classes.name: OpenRequest
classes.description: Request from web to background to download a file.

classes.name: OpenBuganizerResponse
classes.description: Response containing bug report attachment details.

classes.name: AttachmentMetadata
classes.description: Metadata for attachments in bug reports.

classes.name: BugReportMetadata
classes.description: Metadata extracted from bug report filenames.

methods.name: MessageType
methods.description: Enumeration of message types for communication.
